name: Ray-based Photometric Loss for Heat Kernel Textures
definition: A training objective for Heat Kernel Textures (HKTex) that minimizes the difference between predicted and target ray colors in a multi-view setting, using synthetic rendered images as ground truth to avoid baking lighting/shadows into diffuse albedo.
summary: This method trains Heat Kernel Textures by minimizing ray color differences using synthetic ground truth to prevent baking lighting and shadows into diffuse albedo.
